What changed (text excerpt):
Added:
+ FY27 Annual Attorney Registration is Open
+ Attorney license renewal and Guardian ad Litem license renewal may be completed in the MyBoardAccess portal from July 1 through August 31, 2026 at 5:00 pm.
+ Pursuant to M. Bar R. 4,
+ Registration documents and payments received after August 31st will be assessed a non-waivable late fee.
+ We greatly appreciate your updated contact information, proxy, and IOLTA account listing, and service email for court service and notices.
+ If your status has changed since last year:
+ new law clerk
+ clerkship ended or is ending soon
+ retired seeking to be Inactive
+ new judge
+ no longer a judge
+ active military or changing status
+ seeking to become active again
+ Before you register in the portal, please contact
+ execassistant@mebaroverseers.org
+ to request a status change.
+ Please note, if you still owe a CLE late fee your license renewal/registration cannot be approved until that is resolved.
+ Registration is completed online on the
+ MyBoardAccess
+ by clicking on the Renew Registration section of the Board's web portal. A confirmation email will automatically be sent to you from informe.org when your registration is approved.
+ 7/1/2026
+ In re: Felix R. Hagenimana
